title: Transit ingestion drain timeout log missing queue depth
description: On ingestion drain timeout (transit/main.rs line 934), the warn log says 'ingestion drain timeout, forcing exit' with no count of how many articles were still queued. The reader's equivalent log includes remaining_connections=N. A maintainer debugging a stuck drain has no way to know from the log whether 1 or 1000 articles were in flight. The RUNBOOK log-message table (RUNBOOK.md line 411) also omits any queue-depth field for this message. Fix: snapshot ingestion_sender.depth() before the timeout fires and include it in the warn\! call.
